tables.label: Table 1
tables.caption: Peptide code, sequence, molecular weight and their respective MIC values against Escherichia coli, Gentamicin resistant MRSA and Mycobacterium smegmatis in the presence and absence of serum.
footnotes: The MIC values are expressed in micro-molar (µM) units. The mammalian cytotoxicity potential of the peptides is shown as percent hemolysis. Small letters denote D amino acids within the peptide sequences.
